N.description: Number of rows in the tensor.

M.description: Number of columns in the tensor.

k.description: The sub-diagonal at and below which the array is filled. `k = 0` is the main diagonal, while `k < 0` is below it, and `k > 0` is above. The default is 0. dtype: Data type of the returned tensor. The default is "float32".

output.description: Tensor with its lower triangle filled with ones and zeros elsewhere. `T[i, j] == 1` for `j <= i + k`, 0 otherwise.
